title: Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professional agent tasks often depend on conventions that are absent from public corpora, yet benchmarks rarely control whether an agent has access to those conventions. We introduce a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates a task instruction from a compact artefact containing private conventions, reference tables, and utility operators. Construction-time provenance, byte-identical task instructions across the provided- and withheld-artefact conditions, leak audits, and executable witnesses make dependence on the artefact explicit and testable. Across fifteen calibration tasks, one frontier agent configuration achieves a 68.0% pass rate with the artefact and 0% without it; on one task, a plausible but incorrect artefact also yields 0% across five trials. translated_title: 无知还是无能？为LLM智能体构建知识门控的可验证任务
translated_abstract: 专业智能体任务往往依赖于公共语料库中不存在的惯例约定，然而现有基准测试很少控制智能体是否能够获取这些惯例。我们提出了一种知识门控的任务构建协议，将任务指令与一个包含私有惯例、参考表和实用算子的紧凑工件分离开来。构建时的来源追踪、在提供工件与隐去工件两种条件下字节完全一致的任务指令、泄漏审计以及可执行见证，使得对工件的依赖变得明确且可测试。在十五个校准任务中，一个前沿智能体配置在使用工件时达到68.0%的通过率，而在没有工件时通过率为0%；在其中一个任务上，即使提供一个看似合理但不正确的工件，五次试验的通过率也为0%。确定性求解器和规则语料库为结构化任务提供了精确的真值，而命名的标准级评分细则则支持无法通过程序自动校验的输出。
tldr: 本文提出一种知识门控的任务构建协议，通过将任务指令与包含私有惯例的工件分离，并利用来源追踪、泄漏审计和可执行见证等机制，使LLM智能体对私有知识的依赖变得明确且可验证，实验显示使用工件时通过率达68.0%而无工件时为0%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates task instructions from artifacts containing private conventions, using provenance tracking, leak audits, and executable witnesses to make LLM agents' dependence on private knowledge explicit and verifiable, achieving a 68.0% pass rate with the artifact versus 0% without it.
